note: FULL held-out re-forward: every example in the 20% stratified held-out split (random_state=7, matches src/train_probe.py) is re-forwarded through Gemma to capture per-token activations. subset_* AUCs are therefore on the FULL split — they are no longer a subset estimate. Use --limit N to fall back to a capped stratified sub-sample (matches scripts/eval_maxpool.py).
